enabledTip: When off, the toolbar keeps SiYuan's native behaviour (stays until the next click)
nearDistanceTip: The toolbar stays fully opaque within this distance; the farther away, the fainter it gets
farDistanceTip: The toolbar is closed immediately past this distance (no delay, no re-showing). At exactly this distance it is still visible, only faint
restartHint: Fully opaque within 20 → fainter with distance → closed immediately past 200. Changes apply instantly, no restart needed
